newsitem.title: USA: Bi sees Q1 EPS range of $0.02 to $0.04.
newsitem.headline: Bi sees Q1 EPS range of $0.02 to $0.04.

text.p: BI Inc said Thursday that earnings for its first quarter, ending September 30, are expected to be in a range of $0.02 to $0.04 per share.
The company provides electronic home arrest and institutional management systems.
The first quarter shortfall is largely due to flatness in the monitoring population and its result on recurring revenue, a statement from the company said.

Management believed that direct sales revenues would compensate for the shortfall, but has determined that direct sales revenues for the quarter would likely not make up the difference, the statement said.
The company said its fundamentals remain strong.
Also announced by BI was the signing of a letter of intent to acquire Peregrine Corrections Inc of Denver for $2,250,000 in combined cash and common stock.
The company said it expects to finalize the acquisition within the next 90 days.
